cases.reading_scope: Main article all4pages264–267 and Figure1A–J; entire TableS1 DOCX26rows11columns plus key, both rendered pages; entire single-frame FigureS1 TIFF panelsA/B. Source text, layout and figures inspected.
cases.case_genotype: Index female=Sibling1=TableS1Patient1; heterozygous c.5395G>A p.Glu1799Lys in both siblings. Main narrative, TableS1 and FigureS1A agree.
cases.inheritance_phase: Both siblings heterozygous by Sanger; parentage confirmed. Parent blood negative by Sanger and high-depth amplicon sequencing without a numeric detection limit stated. Paired reads link allele to shared paternal SNP rs2275527 (FigureS1B). Paternal gonadal mosaicism is inferred, not measured in germ cells.
cases.causal_evidence: Authors attribute Smith-Kingsmore syndrome to a previously reported recurrent MTOR variant; this article provides segregation/sequence evidence, not a new mutant functional assay. Index also inherited BOTH paternal PKD1 variants c.6643C>T p.Arg2215Trp and c.11712G>C (possible exon42 splice effect); authors leave which PKD1 allele causes familial renal disease under investigation. Renal cysts are a mixed-etiology observation. Authors explicitly cannot conclusively implicate MTOR in intestinal polyps.
cases.hpo_locator: Main pp264–265 index-case narrative, Figure1A–G; TableS1 Patient1 column. FigureS1 documents sequence evidence, not phenotype.
limitations: Kidney cysts are observed but not established MTOR-attributable findings; familial PKD1 variants provide a competing explanation.
Ileum/cecum/colon polyps and rectal bleeding are observed; causal attribution to MTOR remains uncertain in the paper.
Learning difficulties, special-needs schooling and developmental delay do not supply a formal intellectual-disability assessment.
Birthweight90th percentile and length>97th percentile support high birth size, but a categorical large-for-gestational-age threshold/gestational-age basis is not independently established.
Parent blood negativity does not exclude low-level somatic mosaicism; gonadal mosaicism is inferred.
Prior functional literature cited in this paper was not independently reread for this bounded case review.
